findings.summary: Wire transport between native-Claude coder and Codex verifier works (request delivered, one validated same-pool response correlated by msg_id/conversation_id, no coms_send used to answer), BUT the Codex verifier reports it does not expose the PRD-named coms_await/coms_respond MCP tools and instead uses its harness's native inbound response path.
findings.confirmed_root_cause: Source-verified: term-control-center/server/launchPlan.ts:213-216 (nativeComsMcpServer) attaches the coms-mcp server (which registers coms_list/coms_send/coms_await/coms_get/coms_respond) ONLY when nativeClaude(profile) is true. Non-native (Codex/Pi) verifier panes receive no coms-mcp server, so the PRD-named coms_* MCP tools are absent by design; the Codex verifier participates via its harness-native coms path. This makes FR-2/FR-4/FR-7's literal 'both peers call coms_list / coms_await / coms_respond' expectation unsatisfiable on the Codex side even though wire-level interop works.
findings.adjudication_needed: Whether FR-2/FR-4/FR-7 require the literally named coms_* MCP tools on the Codex verifier (implying a follow-up PRD to widen the coms-mcp surface to non-native runtimes, or a PRD wording change), or are satisfied by the functionally equivalent single correlated same-pool response with no coms_send used.
findings.update_2026_07_18: Clarified per verifier checkpoint (PRD242-F3 correction): the verifier's coms_await_exposed=true proves tool-NAME exposure only. Its exposed coms_await requires an outbound msg_id (outbound-correlation await); it is NOT the adapter's optional-msg_id inbound-await surface, and both inbound requests arrived via the harness listener, not an inbound coms_await call. Therefore FR-4 failed on BOTH halves under the pre-amendment literal wording, even though functional interop (one correlated same-pool response, no coms_send) worked. Superseded 2026-07-19: the applied amendment accepts these runtime paths; see resolution above.

findings.summary: FR-6/AC-4 timeout-first behavior was not demonstrated in run 1 because the fast verifier replied during coder turn latency.
